About

I am a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at NVIDIA (Deep Learning Toolkit Development). Previously, I was a Research Fellow at DATA61, CSIRO (ICV group). I received my Ph.D. from Monash University (Australia), supervised by A/Prof. Mehrtash Harandi and Prof. Tom Drummond. I completed my bachelor degree at Monash University and Central South University (2+2 program).

Currently working on:

  • 3D scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis (Neural Radiance Fields)
  • 3D reconstruction of surfaces and dense point clouds from images
  • Game automation development
Recent News
  • Started position at NVIDIA as Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Shanghai)
